title: Loved by Over 3,500 Happy Smiles
subtitle: Read real experiences from patients who conquered dental fear and restored their confidence.

reviews.author: Emily Richardson
reviews.quote: I hid my smile in photos for 10 years. Dr. Mitchell crafted veneers so natural that people just assume I have great genetics. Life-changing experience!

reviews.author: Mark Henderson
reviews.quote: Broke a front molar during a weekend biking trip. Called their emergency line, was in the chair within an hour, and left pain-free. Outstanding team.

reviews.author: Sophia Lin
reviews.quote: My kids used to scream before dentists. Here they watch cartoons with noise-cancelling headphones and get excited about appointments. 10/10!
